title: The End of Suburbia - 52 minute documentary on peak oil
summary: A 52-minute short version of the documentary The End of Suburbia, about peak oil and the end of cheap energy. It argues that American suburbs depend on cheap oil and may become the slums of the future.
why: Recommended in threads on suburbs, energy and urbanism as an entertaining, if biased, case for suburbia's dependence on cheap oil.

quote.text: It's entertaining and, IMO, well worth watching even if you disagree with some of the people they interview
